JamesSuckling.com sees China as one of the most important wine markets in the world, and that is why we work exclusively with China’s state-owned wine merchant COFCO to publish wine scores and valuable tasting notes in Chinese. Stay in the loop by reading this weekly wrap-up, which is essentially a quick summary of what was published on COFCO x JS Channel . “ 微信一周” 旨在总结过去一週在 JSx名庄荟 发放的信息，作为JamesSuckling.com 在国内的主要平台，让我们回顾过去一週的信息 . Interview with Drinks Business Hong Kong | Drinks Business 专访
詹姆斯·萨克林是世界首屈一指的酒评人之一，在他30余年的品饮生涯中积累了丰富的经验。詹姆斯在与Drinks Business Hong Kong 的访问中谈及了对未来的愿景，如欲了解最真实的JS， 请查看dbHK对JS的采访记录。
如欲查看英语版本， 请按这里。
With more than 30 years of experience, James Suckling is one of the most influential and prominent wine critics in the world. He has developed his own brand JamesSuckling.com, an international online media platform where he shares wine scores, tasting notes, documentaries and more. In this interview with Drinks Business Hong Kong, he offers further insight into the future of the wine market. Click here to read the full interview.
